tasks.title: Essay: Supporting small businesses
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing how to support small businesses in your local area. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important way to help small businesses succeed?

Notes

Write about:

1. providing free business advice
2. reducing local taxes for new businesses
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: Small business workshop
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you attended a workshop for small business owners? Write a review of the workshop for our magazine.

Describe what the workshop covered, say how useful it was for developing practical skills, and explain whether you would recommend it to other people thinking of starting a business.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Young people and small businesses
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a youth website.

Articles wanted!

Small businesses in our town

What can young people do to support small businesses in our area? Write an article for our website.

Suggest one practical way young people can help, explain why it would make a difference, and describe what the result might look like for the local economy.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Business plan feedback
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Sam.

From: Sam
Subject: My new business idea

Hi,
I'm planning to start a small business selling handmade jewellery online. I've heard your town has a business incubator that helps new entrepreneurs. Could you tell me what kind of support they offer? Also, do you think it's better to sell online or at local markets? And what's the biggest challenge you think I might face?

Thanks a lot!
Sam

Write your email.
